motion_text: Councilmember Mock moved, seconded by Morzel, to approve Consent Agenda items 3-A through 3-G as amended to include Emergency Ordinance No. 7066 for Item 3-G (1).
vote_text: The motion carried: 8-0, Lopez absent.

motion_text: Councilmember Corson moved, seconded by Morzel, to respond to Denver letting them know that due to risks being higher than anticipated, City of Boulder cannot pursue obtaining Currigan Hall at this time but supports preservation of the building and urges their consideration of other proposals. Further, that if no other parties are identified, the City of Boulder may still be interested in the future.
vote_text: The motion carried: 8-0, Lopez absent.

motion_text: Councilmember Morzel moved, seconded by Corson, to adopt Ordinance No. 7054 to approve an Intergovernmental Agreement with Boulder County, City of Louisville, Town of Superior and the City of Boulder entitled, “US 36 Corridor Comprehensive Development Plan”.
vote_text: The motion carried:8-0, Lopez absent.

motion_text: Councilmember Mock moved, seconded by Corson, to approve the 28 th Street CEAP (South Segment) “Hello Boulder” with consideration to be given to suggestions raised by Council.
vote_text: The motion carried: 8-0, Lopez absent.

motion_text: Councilmember Morzel moved, seconded by Mock, to introduce and order published by title only Ordinance No. 7065 vacating six access easements located within the Devil's Thumb Subdivision.
vote_text: The motion carried: 8-0, Lopez absent.

motion_text: There being no further business to come before Council at this time, BY MOTION REGULARLY ADOPTED, THE MEETING WAS ADJOURNED AT 9:34 p.m.
Councilmember Corson moved, seconded by Lopez, to approve Consent Agenda items 3-A through 3-D.
vote_text: The motion carried: 7-0, Morzel and Riggle absent.

motion_text: Councilmember Havlick moved, seconded by Poinsatte, to call-up the Site Review and Use Review for a 200 room, 55 foot tall hotel, a 55 foot tall civic use building, and a 656 space underground parking garage at 9th Street and Canyon Boulevard.
vote_text: The motion failed: 2-4, Havlick and Poinsatte in favor, Eldridge recused, Morzel and Riggle absent.

motion_text: Mayor Toor moved, seconded by Councilmember Havlick to support H.B. 1223, with the amendments proposed by Representative Plant while acknowledging the concerns outlined by the City Attorney and directing him to work toward further amendments which would clarify the language of the bill.
vote_text: The motion carried: 7-0, Morzel and Riggle absent.

motion_text: Councilmember Mock moved, seconded by Havlick, to introduce and publish by title only Ordinance No. 7042 amending the current food service license requirement by adding a new chapter 12 "Food Service Establishment Excise Tax" to Title 3 "Revenue and Taxation," and amending Section 4-20-9 "Food Service and Vending Machine Operator License Fees" and amending Chapter 4-9 "Food Service Establishment Tax License and Food Vending Machine Tax License" of the Boulder Revised Code 1981.
vote_text: The motion carried: 7-0, Morzel and Riggle absent.

motion_text: Councilmember Havlick moved, seconded by Mock, to introduce and publish by title only Ordinance No. 7043 amending Chapter 2 "Beverages License" of Title 4 "Licenses and Permits" of the Boulder Revised Code 1981.
vote_text: The motion carried: 7-0, Morzel and Riggle absent.

motion_text: Councilmember Mock moved, seconded by Havlick, to introduce and publish by title only Ordinance No. 7044 amend the Major Street Setback Map, Appendix C-1, of the Land Use Regulations, removing the Major Street designation for Broadway, Canyon Boulevard, Folsom, Pearl and Walnut within the areas bounded by Iris, Baseline, Folsom Avenue, and the west City limits.
vote_text: The motion carried: 7-0, Morzel and Riggle absent.

motion_text: Councilmember Havlick moved, seconded by Corson, to introduce and publish by title only Ordinance No. 7045 authorize the City Manager to enter into an agreement for the reservation of Residential Growth Management Allocations for the Dakota Ridge Village Subdivision.
vote_text: The motion carried: 7-0, Morzel & Riggle absent.

motion_text: There being no further business to come before Council at this time, BY MOTION REGULARLY ADOPTED, THE MEETING WAS ADJOURNED AT 9:18 p.m.
Councilmember Mock moved, seconded by Morzel, to approve Consent Agenda items 3-A through 3-E.
vote_text: The motion carried: 7-0, Eldridge and Havlick absent.

motion_text: Councilmember Morzel moved, seconded by Riggle, to request that Planning Board evaluate the elimination of the Planning Reserve by changing it to a Rural Preserve in addition to the current proposal to change to 159 acres of Planning Reserve to Rural Preserve adopted by Council on September 5, 2000.
vote_text: The motion carried: 5-2, Corson and Lopez opposed, Eldridge and Havlick absent.

motion_text: Councilmember Morzel moved, seconded by Mock , to adopt Option No. 3, to defer Land Use Map changes for Area Plans.
vote_text: The motion carried: 4-3, Corson, Lopez and Poinsatte opposed, Eldridge and Havlick absent.

motion_text: Councilmember Morzel moved, seconded by Poinsatte, to direct staff to look at the potential for reducing Commercial Land Use Designations in Area 1 (including options for reducing job growth).
vote_text: The motion carried: 6 - 1, Lopez opposed, Eldridge and Havlick.

motion_text: Councilmember Mock moved, seconded by Morzel, to adopt Resolution No. 862. encouraging the citizens of the City of Boulder to oppose Amendment No. 21 also known as “Taxcut 2000,” when voting in the November 7, 2000 election.
vote_text: The motion carried: 7-0, Eldridge and Havlick absent.

motion_text: Councilmember Corson moved, seconded by Morzel, to support Boulder County Ballot Question 1B authorizing the extension of the County's existing .10% recycling and composting sales and use tax for eight years and for the issuance of up to $80,800,000 in bonds, for the purchase and maintenance of open space.
vote_text: The motion carried: 7-0, Eldridge and Havlick absent.

motion_text: Mayor Toor moved, seconded by Mock, to adopt Ordinance No.7078, adopting Chapter 6-12, B.R.C. 1981, regulating trash haulers and recyclable materials as amended.
vote_text: The motion carried: 7-0, Eldridge and Havlick absent.

motion_text: Councilmember Morzel moved, seconded by Riggle, to approve the Greenways Master Plan projects and opportunities.
vote_text: The motion carried: 7-0. Eldridge and Havlick absent.

motion_text: Councilmember Mock moved, seconded by Lopez, to introduce and order published by title only Ordinance No.7083, amending Sections 5-6-2 and 5-6-6, B.R.C. 1981, concerning blank cartridges, fireworks, and exempting certain devices for ceremonial or other purposes as amended.
vote_text: The motion carried: 7-0, Eldridge and Havlick absent.

motion_text: There being no further business to come before Council at this time, BY MOTION REGULARLY ADOPTED, THE MEETING WAS ADJOURNED AT 9:45 p.m.
